values: 潘多拉释放魔盒中的灾祸，不分敌我地影响除自己以外的所有角色。
Pandora opens her box and lets disaster loose. Everyone on the battlefield, friend or foe, is affected. She alone is spared.
潘多拉的魔盒中存有灾祸和希望，被动地，潘多拉自身受到希望的庇护，不受本技能效果影响。主动释放时，潘多拉打开魔盒释放其中的灾祸，使场上所有角色向所属阵营方向恐惧5秒，并在此期间每0.5秒流失50% + 5% ATK的生命值。恐惧效果结束后受其影响角色的攻击力将下降10%，持续8秒，最多叠加3次。

Pandora's box holds both calamity and hope. 
Passive. Pandora herself is protected by hope and is not affected by this skill.
Active. Pandora opens the box to unleash calamity, causing all units on the battlefield to flee in fright toward their own side for 5s and lose 50% + 5% ATK HP per 0.5s in the process. When the fright effect wears off, their ATK is reduced by 10% for 8s. This ATK reduction effect can stack up to 3 times.
每0.5秒流失的生命值提升至55% + 5% ATK。
Increases enemy's HP loss to 55% + 5% ATK every 0.5s.
每0.5秒流失的生命值提升至60% + 5% ATK。
Increases enemy's HP loss to 60% + 5% ATK every 0.5s.
每0.5秒流失的生命值提升至65% + 5% ATK。
Increases enemy's HP loss to 65% + 5% ATK every 0.5s.
每0.5秒流失的生命值提升至70% + 5% ATK。
Increases enemy's HP loss to 70% + 5% ATK every 0.5s.
战斗开始时将友军吸入魔盒，为其恢复能量。
When a battle starts, Pandora pulls an ally into her box and restores their Energy.
战斗开始时，将最靠后的一名友军吸入魔盒中，使其处于无敌状态，但无法释放任何技能。经过4秒后，将其从魔盒内放出。若放出该友军时潘多拉依然存活，则该名友军获得1000点能量，并在接下来10秒内攻击力增加35% + 5%。

When a battle starts, Pandora pulls the rearmost ally into her box, making them invincible but unable to cast skills. After 4s, the ally is released from the box. If Pandora is still alive when that happens, the ally gains 1000 Energy, as well as 35% + 5% ATK for the next 10s.
友军攻击力提升幅度增加至40% + 5%。
When released from the box, the ally gains 40% + 5% ATK.
友军攻击力提升幅度增加至45% + 5%。
When released from the box, the ally gains 45% + 5% ATK.
友军攻击力提升幅度增加至50% + 5%。
When released from the box, the ally gains 50% + 5% ATK.
潘多拉受到魔盒的“侵蚀”，根据“侵蚀”层数对敌人施加负面效果。
Pandora is corrupted by her box, allowing her to inflict debuffs on enemies based on her current Corruption stacks.

被动地，潘多拉每次释放普通攻击以外的技能时，为从魔盒中放出的友军恢复290% + 25% ATK生命值和90 + 10点能量，同时魔盒会因此释放“侵蚀”，使潘多拉和随机一名未被“侵蚀”的敌人受到伤害永久提升10%，潘多拉自身的“侵蚀”最多叠加4次，敌人的“侵蚀”不可叠加。
主动释放时，潘多拉使随机一名敌人在接下来10秒内随机获得以下若干种负面效果（负面效果的施加数量等同于潘多拉自身的“侵蚀”层数）：急速下降45点、回能效率下降45%、受愈下降45点、普通攻击有45%的概率落空。这些负面效果均不可叠加，优先对未被此主动释放效果影响的敌人释放。

Passive. Each time Pandora casts her skills, she restores 290% + 25% ATK HP and 90 + 10 Energy to the ally she released from her box. At the same time, the box applies Corruption, a permanent debuff that increases damage taken by 10%, to both Pandora and one random enemy not yet affected by Corruption. Pandora's Corruption can stack up to 4 times, while the enemy's Corruption does not stack.
Active. Pandora inflicts a random number of unique debuffs on an enemy over the next 10s, prioritizing enemies not already affected by this skill. The number of unique debuffs is equal to Pandora's current Corruption stacks. These debuffs may include: reducing Haste by 45, reducing Energy recovery by 45%, reducing Vitality by 45, or causing the affected unit's normal attacks to have a 45% chance to miss. These effects do not stack.
为友军的恢复提升至300% + 25% ATK生命值和100 + 10点能量。
Increases HP and Energy restored to the ally to 300% + 25% ATK and 100 + 10, respectively.
为友军的恢复提升至310% + 25% ATK生命值和110 + 10点能量。
Increases HP and Energy restored to the ally to 310% + 25% ATK and 110 + 10, respectively.
为友军的恢复提升至320% + 25% ATK生命值和120 + 10点能量。
Increases HP and Energy restored to the ally to 320% + 25% ATK and 120 + 10, respectively.
战斗中，最大生命值提升，受到魔盒的侵蚀后则进一步提升最大生命值。
During battle, Pandora's max HP increases, and by an extra amount after being corrupted by her box.
战斗中，自身最大生命值提升12%，受到魔盒的侵蚀后额外提升6%。
During battle, Pandora's max HP increases by 12%, and by an additional 6% after being corrupted by her box.
战斗中，自身最大生命值提升18%，受到魔盒的侵蚀后额外提升9%。
During battle, Pandora's max HP increases by 18%, and by an additional 9% after being corrupted by her box.
战斗中，自身最大生命值提升24%，受到魔盒的侵蚀后额外提升12%。
During battle, Pandora's max HP increases by 24%, and by an additional 12% after being corrupted by her box.
魔盒在潘多拉被击败后继续留在场上，无法被摧毁。
Pandora's box remains on the battlefield after she is defeated and cannot be destroyed.
自身被击败后魔盒可留在场上，魔盒不会被优先选为目标，处于霸体状态且不可摧毁，拥有1000点能量上限，每秒恢复45点能量，能量满时，魔盒会再次释放终极技能“灾厄释放”，但不再产生生命流失效果。每隔5秒，魔盒对随机一名敌人释放“致命侵蚀”，但只会随机选择一种负面效果。

After Pandora is defeated, the box stays on the battlefield. It's indestructible, unaffected, and won't be prioritized as a target. It has an Energy cap of 1,000 and recovers 45 Energy per second. At full Energy, the box unleashes Panic Projection again, but without the HP loss effect. Every 5s, it also casts Tainted Tribute on a random enemy but inflicts only one random debuff.
魔盒每秒恢复的能量提升至55点。
Increases the box's Energy recovery to 55 per second.
终极技能“灾厄释放”产生的攻击力下降效果对敌方的持续时间变为永久。
Panic Projection's ATK reduction effect on enemies becomes permanent.
魔盒每秒恢复的能量提升至65点。
Increases the box's Energy recovery to 65 per second.
放入魔盒的友军不受潘多拉终极技能的影响。
Allies placed inside the box are immune to Pandora's Ultimate.
放入魔盒的友军永久获得希望的庇护，不受技能“灾厄释放”的效果影响，本效果在潘多拉被击败后依旧生效。
The ally pulled into Pandora's box is permanently protected by hope, making them immune to Panic Projection. This effect remains even after Pandora is defeated.
